Amir Qureshi: quick proposal 3 SI Concierge pilot: combine marketplace checklist + 2-hour HW triage office hours. goal: reduce go-live friction and speed listings. thoughts? :zap:
Dana Lopez: love it. propose concierge desk slots (2x/day) for first 2 weeks after signup. include a dedicated engineer + docs link.
Priyanka Mehta: need a standard intake form for issues (deploy, auth, perf, billing). also add a required pre-check step: smoke harness pass before booking concierge.
vendor-orbit-bot: OrbitRack: holding a reduced-support window 2024-09-22..2024-09-29 for concierge pilots. AUP required for recordings.
Amir Qureshi: good catch. Dana, can you draft the intake CSV + a short SLA (response within 4h during concierge hours)?
Dana Lopez: will do. intake fields: si_name, contact, issue_type, preferred_slot, sandbox_id, consent_recording. sample row: 
```
Acme Systems, ops@acme.com, deploy, 2024-09-23 10:00PT, sandbox-42, yes
```
Priyanka Mehta: also propose a tiny troubleshooting playbook for concierge engineers: common fixes and escalation toes. i'll author a 1-page doc.
Amir Qureshi: target: publish pilot landing page + signup form by Mon (1770076800). onboarding-bot, please create planning invite for Tue readout.
onboarding-bot: calendar invite created: "SI Concierge Pilot Readout" Tue 11:00 PT. attendees: Amir Qureshi, Dana Lopez, Priyanka Mehta. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/si-concierge
Dana Lopez: noted. i'll add a short feedback survey for SIs post-session so we can iterate. :white_check_mark:
Priyanka Mehta: will include a mentor-note template so engineers can capture root cause + fix for the knowledge base.
Amir Qureshi: thanks team. keep notes here and ping if vendor AUP is delayed. :rocket:
